9 God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord. (1 Corinthians 1:9 KJV)

Jesus didn’t die just to keep us from going to hell, but he died to bring us into fellowship with Him and Father God (1 John 1:3). This fellowship is not somewhere off in the future, but for us that have been born again, it is now in this present world. Most Christians are taught by religion that our salvation is all about the future of being able to go to heaven, but that is not what it is about. It is for us now, in this life, to enjoy the fellowship with Jesus and Father God (John 17:3), and have the blessings that are ours now.

If you are a born again Christian, then you should be having an intimate fellowship with God and Jesus now, and enjoying all the benefits that Jesus sacrifice provided for us. Read the Bible, and learn what all we have now in this life on earth, and enjoy your salvation now: Not just when you get to heaven. Thank you Jesus for bringing us back into relationship with the Father!
